name: Jarvis Beta
changes_cs: Verejna beta pro UI/UX testovani: souvisly TabView pro soubory projektu, GitHub a nahled souboru, oprava prekresleni nahledu po otevreni souboru a odolnejsi Project Intake cache.
changes_en: Public UI/UX beta: a continuous TabView for project files, GitHub and file preview, a file-preview repaint fix after opening a file, and more resilient Project Intake caching.
